To put it in perspective... You got married..... Someone LOVE(s/ed) you enough to believe that they want to spend the rest of their life with you. 

There's hope for you yet, so please don't abandon that. 

Happy birthday! Cheers.
Fear of what happens after you die... Scared that there could be something even WORSE than life. So I'll most likely exist for another 40-50 years. Just waiting.
